hooks.command: report() { printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":%s}}' "$(printf '%s' "$1" | jq -Rs .)"; }; git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0; git fetch --quiet origin 2>/dev/null || { report "git sync skipped: fetch failed (offline?)"; exit 0; }; git rev-parse @{u} >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; set -- $(git rev-list --left-right --count @{u}...HEAD 2>/dev/null); behind=${1:-0}; ahead=${2:-0}; if [ "$behind" = 0 ]; then exit 0; elif [ "$ahead" = 0 ]; then git merge --ff-only @{u} >/dev/null 2>&1 && report "git sync: pulled $behind commit(s)" || report "GIT PULL FAILED: $behind behind but fast-forward blocked (local uncommitted changes?). Resolve this FIRST before other work."; else report "GIT PULL FAILED: branch diverged (local $ahead / upstream $behind), not fast-forwardable. Resolve this FIRST before other work; do not blind-merge."; fi
